a: “Sınıfta kimse Elif kadar zeki değil” = Elif sınıfın en zekisidir: “Elif is the cleverest student in the class.” “Some students are cleverer than Elif” ve benzerleri Elif’i başkalarının gerisine koyarak anlamı tersine çevirir.

s: "He started working here in 2018." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: He has been working here since 2018.
He will start working here in 2028.
a: 2018’de burada çalışmaya başlaması, o zamandan beri çalışmayı sürdürdüğü şeklinde yeniden yazılabilir: “He has been working here since 2018.” “He worked here until 2018” 2018’i başlangıç değil bitiş yılı yapar.

s: "You should have told me about the problem earlier." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: You were wrong not to tell me about the problem sooner.
You told me about the problem much earlier than necessary.
I'm glad that you told me about the problem so early.
You must tell me about the problem now, before it's too late.
a: “Should have + V3” geçmişte yapılmayan bir şey için eleştiri bildirir: sorunu bana daha önce söylemeliydin, yani söylememen yanlıştı. “I’m glad that you told me … so early” söylendiğini varsayar ve eleştiriyi memnuniyete çevirir.

s: "Although it was raining, they played football." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: They played football in spite of the rain.
They didn't play football because of the rain.
They played football before the rain started.
The rain stopped, so they played football.
a: “Although + yan cümle” ile “in spite of + ad” aynı zıtlığı verir: yağmura rağmen futbol oynadılar. “Because of the rain” yağmuru sebep yapar ve oynamadıklarını söyler; “The rain stopped, so …” ise yağmurun sürdüğü bilgisini değiştirir.

s: "I'm sure he didn't steal the money." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: He can't have stolen the money.
He must have stolen the money.
He might have stolen the money.
He shouldn't have stolen the money.
a: Geçmişe ait kesin olumsuz çıkarım “can’t have + V3” ile verilir: “He can’t have stolen the money” (parayı çalmış olamaz). “Must have stolen” kesin olumlu çıkarımdır, yani çaldığından emin olmak demektir; “might have” yalnızca ihtimal bildirir.

s: "If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.
Even if you hurry, you'll miss the train.
You'll catch the train unless you hurry.
You missed the train because you hurried.
a: “Unless” “if … not” anlamına gelir: “Unless you hurry” = “If you don’t hurry”. “You’ll catch the train unless you hurry” sonucu tersine çevirir; “even if you hurry” ise acele etse bile kaçıracağını söyler.

s: "This is the first time I have flown in a helicopter." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I have never flown in a helicopter before.
I have flown in a helicopter many times.
I flew in a helicopter for the first time last year.
I don't want to fly in a helicopter again.
a: “This is the first time I have …” bunun daha önce hiç yaşanmadığını anlatır: “I have never flown in a helicopter before.” “I flew … for the first time last year” ilk deneyimi geçmiş yıla taşır; kaynakta ilk deneyim şu andır.

s: "People say that the castle was built in the 12th century." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The castle is said to have been built in the 12th century.
People are building a castle like the ones from the 12th century.
The castle will be rebuilt as it was in the 12th century.
Nobody knows when the castle was built.
a: “People say that + geçmiş zaman” edilgen yapıda “be said to have + V3” olur: “The castle is said to have been built in the 12th century.” Kale inşa edildiği için edilgen “been built” gerekir. “Nobody knows when the castle was built” söylentiyi bilinmezliğe çevirir.

s: "As soon as she arrived home, she called her mother." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: No sooner had she arrived home than she called her mother.
She had called her mother just before she arrived home.
She arrived home long after she had called her mother.
No sooner had her mother called her than she arrived home.
a: “As soon as” ile “No sooner had … than …” aynı anlamı verir: eve varır varmaz annesini aradı. “No sooner had her mother called her than she arrived home” arayan kişiyi ve olayların sırasını değiştirir.

s: "It is possible that the train has been delayed." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The train may have been delayed.
The train must have been delayed.
The train can't have been delayed.
The train should have been delayed.
a: “It is possible that …” geçmişe dair bir olasılık bildirir; bunun modal karşılığı “may/might have + V3”tür: “may have been delayed”. “Must have been” güçlü kesinlik, “can’t have been” imkânsızlık bildirir.

s: "I regret not studying harder at university." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I wish I had studied harder at university.
I'm happy that I studied hard at university.
I will study harder at university.
I studied too hard at university.
a: “Regret not studying” geçmişte yapılmayan bir şeye pişmanlıktır; bu “wish + past perfect” ile anlatılır: “I wish I had studied harder.” “I’m happy that I studied hard” pişmanlığı ortadan kaldırır; “will study” ise geleceğe dairdir.

s: "The government did nothing until the protests began." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: It was not until the protests began that the government took action.
The government took action long before the protests began.
The protests began because the government acted too quickly.
It was not until the government took action that the protests began.
a: “Protestolar başlayana kadar hükümet hiçbir şey yapmadı” = ancak protestolar başlayınca harekete geçti: “It was not until the protests began that the government took action.” Sonuncu benzer cümle olayların sırasını tersine çevirerek protestoyu hükümet eyleminin sonucu yapar.

s: "The more you practise, the better you get." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Your skills improve as you practise more.
Practising too much makes you worse.
You should practise less to get better.
a: “The more you practise, the better you get” = ne kadar çok pratik yaparsan o kadar iyileşirsin; “Your skills improve as you practise more” aynı orantıyı “as” (-dıkça) ile verir. “Practising too much makes you worse” ilişkiyi tersine çevirir.

s: "Without your help, I couldn't have finished the project." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: If you hadn't helped me, I wouldn't have finished the project.
I managed to finish the project without anyone's help.
You couldn't help me, so I wasn't able to finish the project.
If you help me, I will be able to finish the project on time.
a: “Without your help, I couldn’t have finished” geçmişe ait gerçek dışı koşuldur; “If you hadn’t helped me, I wouldn’t have finished the project” ile aynı anlamdadır: yardım etti ve proje bitti. “I managed to finish … without anyone’s help” yardımı yok sayar.

s: "It took him two hours to repair the car." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: He spent two hours repairing the car.
He repaired the car two hours ago.
The car was repaired in two days.
He needed two people to repair the car.
a: “It took him two hours to …” ile “He spent two hours + -ing” aynı süreyi anlatır. “He repaired the car two hours ago” süreyi değil ne zaman olduğunu söyler; “in two days” ise süreyi değiştirir.

s: "She is too young to drive a car." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: She isn't old enough to drive a car.
She is old enough to drive a car.
She is young, but she drives very well.
She doesn't want to drive because she is young.
a: “Too young to drive” “araba kullanamayacak kadar genç” demektir; bunun eşi “not old enough to drive”dır. “Old enough to drive” olumsuzluğu kaldırır; “she drives very well” ise araba kullanabildiğini söyler.

s: "I'd prefer to stay at home rather than go out tonight." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I would rather stay at home than go out tonight.
I'd like to go out tonight instead of staying at home.
I have to stay at home tonight.
I stayed at home last night instead of going out.
a: “Would prefer to … rather than …” ile “would rather … than …” aynı tercihi bildirir: bu akşam dışarı çıkmaktansa evde kalmayı yeğlerim. “I have to stay at home tonight” tercihi zorunluluğa, “I’d like to go out” ise tercihi tam tersine çevirir.

s: "The concert was cancelled due to the storm." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Because of the storm, the concert didn't take place.
The concert went ahead as planned in spite of the storm.
The storm started shortly after the concert had ended.
The concert was postponed until the storm started.
a: “Due to” ile “because of” eş anlamlıdır; “was cancelled” da “didn’t take place” ile aynı sonucu verir. “Went ahead as planned in spite of the storm” konserin yapıldığını söyler; “postponed” ise iptal değil erteleme demektir.

s: "Hardly anyone came to the meeting." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Very few people attended the meeting.
Nobody wanted the meeting to end.
The meeting was very hard for everyone.
a: “Hardly anyone” “neredeyse hiç kimse, çok az kişi” demektir: “Very few people attended.” “Hardly” burada “zorlukla/güçlükle” anlamında değildir; “very hard for everyone” bu yanlış okumadan doğar. “Almost everyone” ise tersidir.

s: "Despite his injury, he finished the race." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Even though he was injured, he completed the race.
He didn't finish the race because he was injured.
He was injured after he finished the race.
He finished the race and then got injured.
a: “Despite + ad” ile “even though + yan cümle” aynı zıtlığı verir: sakat olmasına rağmen yarışı bitirdi. “He didn’t finish the race because he was injured” sonucu tersine çevirir; “was injured after he finished” ise olayların sırasını değiştirir.

s: "Mehmet is not as experienced as Ayşe." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Ayşe has more experience than Mehmet.
Mehmet has more experience than Ayşe.
Mehmet and Ayşe are equally experienced.
Neither Mehmet nor Ayşe has any experience.
a: “Mehmet is not as experienced as Ayşe” Mehmet’in Ayşe kadar deneyimli olmadığını, yani Ayşe’nin daha deneyimli olduğunu söyler. “Mehmet has more experience” tersidir; “equally experienced” ise “as … as”nın olumlu hâlidir.

s: "They had their house painted last month." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Someone painted their house for them last month.
They painted their house themselves last month.
They are going to paint their house next month.
Their house hasn't been painted for a month.
a: “Have something done” ettirgen yapıdır: evi başkasına boyattılar. “Someone painted their house for them” bunu karşılar. “They painted their house themselves” işi kendilerinin yaptığını söyler, ettirgenliği kaldırır.

s: "There's no point in complaining about the weather." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: It's useless to complain about the weather.
You should complain more about the weather.
Complaining about the weather can change it.
Nobody has ever complained about the weather.
a: “There’s no point in + -ing” bir işin anlamsız ya da boşuna olduğunu anlatır: “It’s useless to complain about the weather.” “Complaining … can change it” işe yarayacağını söyler, tersidir; “You should complain more” de anlamı ters çevirir.

s: "Scarcely had the guests arrived when the power went out." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The power went out just after the guests arrived.
The power had gone out before the guests arrived.
The guests arrived long after the power went out.
The guests left because the power had gone out.
a: “Scarcely had … when …” bir olaydan hemen sonra ötekinin olduğunu anlatır: misafirler gelir gelmez elektrikler kesildi. “The power had gone out before the guests arrived” olayların sırasını tersine çevirir.

s: "Had the doctors acted more quickly, the patient might have survived." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The patient died, perhaps because the doctors were too slow.
The patient survived only because the doctors acted so quickly.
The doctors acted very quickly, but the patient died anyway.
If the doctors act more quickly, the patient may survive the operation.
a: Devrik üçüncü tip koşul: gerçekte hasta öldü, doktorlar yeterince hızlı değildi.

s: "It is widely believed that the painting was stolen by a former employee." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Many people think that a former employee stole the painting.
It has been proven that a former employee stole the painting.
Nobody believes that the painting was stolen.
A former employee reported that the painting had been stolen.
a: “It is widely believed that …” = pek çok kişi … olduğuna inanıyor; bu bir kanaattir, kanıt değil. “It has been proven that a former employee stole the painting” inancı kanıtlanmış bir gerçeğe çevirdiği için anlamı değiştirir.

s: "Only after reading the report did I understand the seriousness of the situation." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I didn't realize how serious the situation was until I read the report.
I understood how serious the situation was long before I read the report.
Reading the report made me think the situation was less serious than it was.
I read the report only because I knew the situation was serious.
a: “Only after reading … did I understand …” anlamanın ancak rapordan sonra gerçekleştiğini söyler; bu “not … until” ile anlatılır: “I didn’t realize … until I read the report.” “I understood … long before I read the report” sırayı tersine çevirir.

s: "Much as I admire his work, I don't agree with his political views." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Although I admire his work, I disagree with his political views.
I don't admire his work very much, and I disagree with his political views.
I admire his work, and I also agree with his political views.
I admire his work so much that I've come to share his political views.
a: “Much as” “-sa da, -masına rağmen” anlamında zıtlık bildirir: çalışmalarına hayranım ama siyasi görüşlerine katılmıyorum. “I admire his work, and I also agree with his political views” zıtlığı kaldırır; “I don’t admire his work very much” ise hayranlığı olumsuzlar.

s: "The project failed not so much because of a lack of money as because of poor management." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The project failed mainly because of poor management rather than a lack of money.
The project failed only because there was not enough money to complete it.
The project succeeded despite poor management and a serious lack of money.
A lack of money, rather than poor management, was the main reason the project failed.
a: “Not so much A as B” “A’dan çok B” demektir: başarısızlığın asıl nedeni para eksikliği değil kötü yönetimdir. “A lack of money, rather than poor management, was the main reason” iki nedeni yer değiştirir; “only because there was not enough money” de yönetimi dışarıda bırakır.

s: "The number of tourists visiting the city has doubled since the new airport opened." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Twice as many tourists have visited the city since the new airport opened.
The new airport was opened because the number of tourists had doubled.
Half as many tourists have visited the city since the new airport opened.
The number of tourists visiting the city will double when the new airport opens.
a: “Has doubled” sayının iki katına çıktığını anlatır; bu “twice as many” ile karşılanır. “Half as many” yarısı demektir; “The new airport was opened because the number had doubled” ise neden ile sonucu yer değiştirir.

s: "Were it not for tourism, the island's economy would collapse." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The island's economy depends heavily on tourism.
Tourism has caused the collapse of the island's economy.
The island's economy is independent of tourism.
The island's economy collapsed because there were no tourists.
a: “Were it not for tourism, the economy would collapse” = turizm olmasaydı ekonomi çökerdi; yani adanın ekonomisi büyük ölçüde turizme bağlıdır. “Tourism has caused the collapse” turizmi çöküşün sebebi yapar; “collapsed because there were no tourists” ise gerçek dışı durumu gerçekleşmiş saymaktadır.

s: "No other mountain in the world is higher than Everest." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Some mountains are higher than Everest.
Everest is as high as several other mountains.
Everest is one of the lowest mountains in the world.
a: “Hiçbir dağ Everest’ten yüksek değil” yapısı (“no other … + karşılaştırma”) en üstünlük anlamı verir: “Everest is the highest mountain.” “Everest is as high as several other mountains” eşitlik bildirir; kaynakta Everest’e eşit yükseklikte bir dağ geçmez.

s: "She was on the point of leaving when the phone rang." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: She was just about to leave when the phone rang.
She had already left when the phone rang.
She left immediately after the phone rang.
She didn't want to leave because the phone rang.
a: “Be on the point of + -ing” bir işi yapmak üzere olmaktır: “was just about to leave”. “She had already left when the phone rang” çıkmış olduğunu söyler; kaynakta ise henüz çıkmamıştır.

s: "There is little likelihood that the negotiations will succeed." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The negotiations are unlikely to succeed.
It is very likely that the negotiations will succeed.
a: “There is little likelihood that …” “… olasılığı düşüktür” demektir: “The negotiations are unlikely to succeed.” “Little” burada “az” anlamındadır; “It is very likely that they will succeed” anlamı tersine çevirir.

s: "However carefully you plan, things can still go wrong." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: No matter how carefully you plan, problems may still occur.
If you plan carefully, nothing will go wrong.
Things go wrong because people plan too carefully.
You don't need to plan carefully because things always go wrong.
a: “However carefully you plan” ile “No matter how carefully you plan” aynı anlamı taşır: ne kadar dikkatli plan yaparsan yap, işler yine de ters gidebilir. “If you plan carefully, nothing will go wrong” “still go wrong” ifadesinin tersini söyler.

s: "The minister denied that she had accepted any bribes." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The minister said that she had not accepted any bribes.
The minister refused to accept bribes in the future.
The minister was accused of not accepting bribes.
a: “Deny that” = … olduğunu inkâr etmek, yani yapmadığını söylemek: “The minister said that she had not accepted any bribes.” “Admitted accepting bribes” inkârı itirafa çevirir; “refused to accept bribes in the future” ise geçmişteki iddiayı geleceğe taşır.

s: "It makes no difference to me whether we go by bus or by train." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I don't mind whether we take the bus or the train.
I would much rather go by train than by bus.
I don't want to go either by bus or by train.
It really matters to me whether we take the bus or the train.
a: “It makes no difference to me whether …” “benim için fark etmez” demektir; bu “I don’t mind whether …” ile aynıdır. “It really matters to me” tersidir; “I would much rather go by train” ise bir tercih bildirir.

s: "Seldom have I read such a well-written book." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: I have rarely read a book as well written as this one.
I often read books that are as well written as this one.
I have never read a book before.
This book is not as well written as others.
a: “Seldom have I read …” devrik bir yapıdır ve “nadiren okudum” anlamı verir: “I have rarely read a book as well written as this one.” “I often read books as well written as this one” “seldom”u tersine çevirir.

s: "The success of the plan depends on everyone's cooperation." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Unless everyone cooperates, the plan will not succeed.
The plan will succeed even if not everyone cooperates.
Everyone cooperated, but the plan failed in the end.
The plan's success has nothing to do with whether people cooperate.
a: Planın başarısı herkesin iş birliğine bağlıysa, herkes iş birliği yapmadıkça plan başarılı olmaz: “Unless everyone cooperates, the plan will not succeed.” “The plan will succeed even if not everyone cooperates” bu bağımlılığı ortadan kaldırır.

s: "In all likelihood, the company will be sold next year." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: The company will probably be sold next year.
The company will definitely not be sold.
The company was sold last year.
It's unlikely that anyone will buy the company.
a: “In all likelihood” “büyük olasılıkla” demektir; bu “probably” ile karşılanır. “It’s unlikely that anyone will buy the company” olasılığı tersine çevirir; “will definitely not be sold” kesin olumsuzluk bildirir.

s: "Contrary to what most people think, the Great Wall of China cannot be seen from space with the naked eye." cümlesine anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?
c: Many people wrongly believe that the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
As most people know, the Great Wall of China can easily be seen from space with the naked eye.
Contrary to popular belief, the Great Wall of China is the only structure visible from space.
Astronauts have often confirmed that the Great Wall of China can be seen from space without any equipment.
a: Çoğu insanın düşündüğünün aksine Çin Seddi uzaydan çıplak gözle görülemez; yani pek çok kişi yanlış olarak görülebildiğine inanır. “As most people know, … can easily be seen” yaygın inanışı doğru kabul ederek anlamı tersine çevirir.

s: Ayşe: Would you like some more tea? / Can: ---- / Ayşe: OK, here you are.
c: Yes, please. Just half a cup.
No, thank you. I've had enough.
I don't drink tea at all.
Tea is very expensive these days.
a: Ayşe çay veriyor ("here you are"), bu yüzden Can evet demiş olmalı.

s: Waiter: Are you ready to order? / Customer: ---- / Waiter: Of course, take your time.
c: Not yet. Could I have a few more minutes?
Yes, I'll have the grilled fish and a salad, please.
Could you bring us the bill, please? We're in a hurry.
Yes, thank you. The food was delicious.
a: Garsonun "acele etmeyin" yanıtı müşterinin biraz daha zaman istediğini gösterir.

s: Mert: I've lost my wallet. / Zeynep: ---- / Mert: I think I left it on the bus.
c: Oh no! Where do you think you lost it?
Oh no! How much money did you have in it?
Don't worry, I've found it. It was in your bag.
Really? When did you buy that new wallet?
a: Mert’in “I think I left it on the bus” cevabı bir yer bildirir; demek ki Zeynep cüzdanı nerede kaybettiğini sormuştur. “How much money did you have in it?” bir miktar sorar, otobüste unuttuğunu söyleyen yanıtla uyuşmaz.

s: Ali: How long have you been learning Spanish? / Elif: ---- / Ali: Wow, you speak it really well!
c: I'd like to learn it next year.
a: “How long have you been learning …?” süre sorar; yanıt bir süre olmalıdır: “For about six months.” Ali’nin “You speak it really well!” tepkisi Elif’in İspanyolca bildiğini gösterir; “I don’t speak Spanish” bu yüzden uymaz.

s: Doctor: What seems to be the problem? / Patient: ---- / Doctor: Let me check your throat.
c: I've had a sore throat for three days.
I'm feeling much better now, thanks.
I broke my leg playing football.
I'd like to make an appointment for next week.
a: Doktorun “Let me check your throat” demesi hastanın boğazından şikâyet ettiğini gösterir: “I’ve had a sore throat for three days.” “I broke my leg playing football” bir şikâyet bildirir ama doktorun boğaza bakmasıyla uyuşmaz.

s: Can: Shall we go to the cinema tonight? / Deniz: ---- / Can: How about tomorrow, then?
c: I'm sorry, I can't. I have to study tonight.
That's a great idea! What time does the film start?
Sure, but I'd rather go tonight than tomorrow.
Yes, let's go tonight. I'll book the tickets now.
a: "O zaman yarına ne dersin?" teklifin reddedildiğini gösterir.

s: Receptionist: Good evening. How can I help you? / Guest: ---- / Receptionist: Certainly. Could I see your passport, please?
c: I have a reservation for two nights under the name Yılmaz.
Could you tell me where the nearest restaurant is, please?
I'd like to check out, please. Here is my room key.
Could you call me a taxi to the airport, please?
a: Pasaport istenmesi giriş işlemi (check-in) olduğunu gösterir.

s: Sinem: Do you know what time the museum opens? / Tourist: ---- / Sinem: Great, we have time for breakfast then.
c: I think it opens at ten.
a: Kahvaltıya zaman olması müzenin daha sonra açıldığını gösterir.

s: Emre: I'm thinking of buying an electric car. / Burak: ---- / Emre: That's true, but they're getting cheaper every year.
c: Electric cars are faster than normal cars.
a: Emre'nin "doğru ama ucuzluyorlar" yanıtı pahalılık itirazını gösterir.

s: Teacher: Why didn't you hand in your homework? / Student: ---- / Teacher: All right, but make sure you bring it tomorrow.
c: I'm sorry, I left it at home.
I finished it last week and gave it to you.
I don't really like doing homework.
I handed it in yesterday, didn't I?
a: Öğretmenin “All right, but make sure you bring it tomorrow” demesi ödevin yapıldığını ama getirilmediğini gösterir: “I’m sorry, I left it at home.” “I don’t really like doing homework” ödevin yapılmadığını söyler; öğretmenin yarın getirmesini istemesiyle uyuşmaz.

s: Gül: I can't believe how crowded the city has become. / Okan: ---- / Gül: Exactly. And the traffic is getting worse every day.
c: I know. So many people have moved here recently.
Really? I think it's much quieter than it used to be.
I know, but at least the traffic is much better now.
I don't mind. I like big cities.
a: Gül "aynen" diyerek katılıyor; Okan da kalabalığı onaylamış olmalı.

s: Interviewer: Why do you want to work for our company? / Applicant: ---- / Interviewer: I see. And what experience do you have in that area?
c: Because I'm interested in renewable energy, and you lead the field.
Because I need a job as soon as possible, to be honest.
To be honest, I don't know much about what your company does.
Because your company offers better salaries than most others.
a: "O alandaki deneyiminiz" sorusu adayın bir alandan bahsettiğini gösterir.

s: Nur: Did you enjoy the concert last night? / Kerem: ---- / Nur: That's a shame. I heard it was great.
c: Actually, I couldn't go. I wasn't feeling well.
Yes, it was the best concert I've ever been to!
I'm going to the concert tonight.
a: Nur’un “That’s a shame. I heard it was great.” yanıtı, Kerem’in konsere gidemediğini gösterir: “Actually, I couldn’t go.” “Yes, it was the best concert” konsere gittiğini söyler; “That’s a shame” tepkisiyle çelişir.

s: Lale: This soup is too salty. / Tarık: ---- / Lale: No, it's fine. I'll just add some water.
c: Shall I ask the waiter to bring you another one?
That's strange. I made it without adding any salt.
Then you should add some more salt to make it better.
Yes, I added extra salt because you like it salty.
a: Lale’nin “No, it’s fine. I’ll just add some water” demesi bir teklifi geri çevirdiğini gösterir; Tarık yeni bir çorba istemeyi önermiştir. “Then you should add some more salt” zaten tuzlu olan çorbaya tuz eklemeyi önerdiği için mantıksızdır.

s: Officer: Can I see your ticket, please? / Passenger: ---- / Officer: I'm afraid you'll have to pay a fine, then.
c: I'm sorry, I didn't have time to buy one.
I'm going to Ankara, and I'll get off at the next stop.
Of course. Is the train going to be late again?
a: Görevlinin “I’m afraid you’ll have to pay a fine, then” (o zaman ceza ödemeniz gerekecek) demesi yolcunun bileti olmadığını gösterir: “I didn’t have time to buy one.” “Here it is, officer” bileti gösterdiğini söyler; o durumda ceza gerekmez.

s: Selim: I'm going to run a marathon next month. / Arda: ---- / Selim: Yes, I've been training for almost a year.
c: Really? You must have been preparing for ages.
Really? Why don't you start training for it, then?
That's great! I ran my first marathon last week too.
Next month? Marathons are far too long for me.
a: Selim'in "bir yıldır antrenman yapıyorum" yanıtı hazırlığa dair bir yorumu karşılar.

s: Ece: Could you help me move this weekend? / Barış: ---- / Ece: Thanks a lot! I'll buy you dinner afterwards.
c: Of course I will. What time should I come over?
Sorry, I'll be out of town this weekend.
I moved house last year, and it was a nightmare.
Moving is very tiring. Why don't you hire someone?
a: Ece’nin “Thanks a lot! I’ll buy you dinner afterwards” yanıtı Barış’ın yardımı kabul ettiğini gösterir: “Of course I will.” “Sorry, I’ll be out of town” reddeder; “Why don’t you hire someone?” ise öneri yaparak yardım etmekten kaçınır.

s: Customer: I bought this shirt yesterday, but it's too small. / Shop assistant: ---- / Customer: No, thanks. I'd prefer a refund.
c: Would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
We don't sell shirts in this size, I'm afraid.
Really? I think it looks great on you.
I'm sorry, but we can't give refunds on sale items.
a: Müşterinin "iade tercih ederim" yanıtı değişim teklifini reddeder.

s: Hande: Have you heard that the library is going to close? / Volkan: ---- / Hande: Because the council says it's too expensive to run.
c: No! Why are they closing it?
I never go to the library.
The library has a lot of books.
a: Hande’nin “Because the council says …” diye sebep açıklaması, Volkan’ın “neden?” diye sorduğunu gösterir: “Why are they closing it?” “Yes, it opened last week” kapanma haberine uymaz; “I never go to the library” ise bir soru sormaz.

s: Pınar: I've been offered a job in Berlin. / Cem: ---- / Pınar: I haven't decided yet. It's a big change.
c: Congratulations! Are you going to accept it?
Why did you refuse such a good offer?
I've never been to Berlin, but I'd love to go.
That's a pity. Did they tell you why they rejected you?
a: "Henüz karar vermedim" yanıtı kabul edip etmeyeceğinin sorulduğunu gösterir.

s: Journalist: Do you think the new law will reduce traffic accidents? / Expert: ---- / Journalist: So you're saying that education is just as important as punishment?
c: Partly, but fines alone won't help; drivers also need better training.
Yes, I'm sure the heavy fines will eliminate almost all accidents within a year.
I haven't read the new law yet, so I can't really comment on it.
Not really, because traffic accidents aren't a serious problem here.
a: Gazeteci eğitimin cezayla eşit önemde olduğunu özetliyor; uzman eğitime vurgu yapmış olmalı.

s: Manager: Our sales have fallen for the third month in a row. / Assistant: ---- / Manager: Maybe, but we can't compete with them on price.
c: It might be because our competitors have cut their prices.
That's great news for the company! We should celebrate.
We should hire more sales staff immediately to fix it.
That's not surprising; our products are the cheapest on the market.
a: "Fiyatta rekabet edemeyiz" yanıtı rakip fiyatlarından bahsedildiğini gösterir.

s: Student: I find it really difficult to concentrate when I study. / Counsellor: ---- / Student: Actually, I usually study with music on and my phone next to me.
c: Do you study in a quiet place without distractions?
You should simply study for longer hours every day.
Concentration isn't really that important when studying.
Why don't you change your major to something easier?
a: Öğrencinin yanıtı dikkat dağıtıcıları sorgulayan bir soruya verilmiş.

s: Patient: Is the operation risky? / Surgeon: ---- / Patient: That's reassuring. When can we schedule it?
c: There's always some risk, but complications are very rare.
Yes, I'm afraid most patients don't survive this operation.
To be honest, I've never performed this operation before.
You don't actually need the operation at all, to be honest.
a: Hastanın “That’s reassuring” (bu içimi rahatlattı) demesi cerrahın riskin düşük olduğunu söylediğini gösterir: her zaman biraz risk vardır ama komplikasyonlar çok nadirdir. “Most patients don’t survive this operation” rahatlatıcı değil, korkutucudur.

s: Neighbour: Your dog barks all night. / Owner: ---- / Neighbour: Thank you. I'd really appreciate that.
c: Sorry! I'll keep him inside at night from now on.
Oh, really? I had no idea he was so noisy.
I'm afraid there's nothing I can do about it.
I'm sorry, but why don't you just buy some earplugs?
a: Komşunun “Thank you. I’d really appreciate that.” demesi, köpek sahibinin bir önlem sözü verdiğini gösterir: Köpeği geceleri içeride tutacaktır. Yalnızca şaşırmak, bir şey yapamayacağını söylemek ya da kulak tıkacı önermek teşekkürle karşılanmaz.

s: Tourist: Is it safe to swim here? / Lifeguard: ---- / Tourist: Then we'll wait until the afternoon.
c: Not at the moment. The waves are too strong this morning.
Yes, it's perfectly safe here all day, even in the afternoon.
No, swimming is not allowed on this beach in the afternoon.
I'm not sure. I'm not a very good swimmer myself.
a: Öğleden sonraya kadar beklemek sabahın güvensiz olduğunu gösterir.

s: Researcher: We need more volunteers for the study. / Professor: ---- / Researcher: Good idea. Students are usually happy to help for course credit.
c: Why don't we put an announcement on the university website?
I'm afraid we already have far too many volunteers for it.
Why don't we offer to pay volunteers from outside the university?
Let's cancel the study if we can't find enough people.
a: Araştırmacının "öğrenciler..." yanıtı üniversite içi duyuru önerisine uyar.

s: Ahmet: I can't decide between studying medicine and engineering. / Teacher: ---- / Ahmet: Definitely biology. I love learning about the human body.
c: Which subjects do you enjoy most at school?
Have you talked to your parents about this decision yet?
How long do you have before you need to apply?
Which of the two would pay better in the long run?
a: Ahmet'in "kesinlikle biyoloji" yanıtı en sevdiği dersin sorulduğunu gösterir.

s: Customer: The internet in my flat has been down since yesterday. / Technician: ---- / Customer: Yes, I've already tried that twice.
c: Have you tried restarting your modem?
You should move to another flat.
a: Müşterinin “Yes, I’ve already tried that twice” demesi teknisyenin denenebilecek bir çözüm önerdiğini gösterir: “Have you tried restarting your modem?” “Your internet is working perfectly” bir iddiadır, “zaten iki kez denedim” cevabıyla uyuşmaz.

s: Mother: You look exhausted. / Daughter: ---- / Mother: You should try to get to bed earlier, then.
c: I was up until three studying for my exam.
I slept for ten hours, but I still feel tired.
I've just walked home from school in the heat.
I skipped lunch because I was so busy.
a: Annenin “You should try to get to bed earlier, then” demesi kızın geç yattığını söylediğini gösterir: sınava çalışırken saat üçe kadar ayaktaydı. “I slept for ten hours” uzun uyuduğunu söyler; erken yatma tavsiyesi bununla uyuşmaz.

s: Ozan: Why are you learning Japanese? / Melis: ---- / Ozan: That sounds amazing! Which city will you be in?
c: I'll be studying in Japan for a year.
Because I've always loved Japanese films and anime.
I need it for a translation course at university.
A Japanese family is coming to stay with us next month.
a: "Hangi şehirde olacaksın" sorusu Japonya'ya gideceğini gösterir.

s: Editor: Your article is too long. / Writer: ---- / Editor: Yes, the section on history could be shortened.
c: Which parts do you think I should cut?
I'll add a few more pages, then.
It's the shortest article I've ever written.
I don't want to write any more articles.
a: Editör kısaltılacak bölümü söylüyor: yazar hangi kısımları sormuş.

s: Policymaker: Raising taxes on sugary drinks will improve public health. / Economist: ---- / Policymaker: Perhaps, but evidence from other countries suggests that consumption does fall.
c: I doubt it. People may just switch to other unhealthy snacks.
I agree, and the extra revenue could fund health campaigns.
Absolutely. Sugar is one of the main causes of obesity in children.
Yes, and many manufacturers have already reduced sugar levels.
a: Politikacının “Perhaps, but evidence … suggests that consumption does fall” cevabı bir itirazı karşılamaktadır; ekonomist şüphesini belirtmiştir: insanlar başka sağlıksız atıştırmalıklara yönelebilir. “I agree …” katılım bildirir; “Perhaps, but …” ile verilen karşı kanıt buna uymaz.

s: Interviewer: What would you say is your greatest weakness? / Candidate: ---- / Interviewer: That's an honest answer. How are you working on it?
c: I sometimes find it hard to delegate tasks to others.
I'd say my greatest strength is working well in a team.
To be honest, I can't think of any real weaknesses.
I'm really looking forward to joining your company.
a: "Bunun üzerinde nasıl çalışıyorsun" sorusu somut bir zayıflık belirtildiğini gösterir.

s: Scientist A: These results seem too good to be true. / Scientist B: ---- / Scientist A: Agreed. Let's repeat the experiment with a larger sample.
c: True. The sample was very small, so they may be unreliable.
I disagree. We followed the procedure very carefully.
I know. We should publish them before anyone else does.
Don't worry. Results like these are quite normal in our field.
a: A'nın "katılıyorum, daha büyük örneklemle tekrar edelim" yanıtı örneklem kaygısına uyar.

s: Activist: The new dam will destroy the valley's ecosystem. / Engineer: ---- / Activist: But no compensation can replace species that disappear forever.
c: We'll offset the damage by restoring habitats elsewhere.
The valley's ecosystem is not as rich as people think.
The construction work won't begin until next year.
Local people were consulted before the project was approved.
a: Aktivistin "hiçbir telafi..." itirazı telafi önlemlerinden bahsedildiğini gösterir.

s: Student: Do you think artificial intelligence will replace teachers? / Professor: ---- / Student: So you mean AI will change the role of teachers rather than eliminate it?
c: Unlikely. AI will handle routine tasks, giving teachers more time for students.
Yes, I think most teaching jobs will disappear within the next decade or so.
It's hard to say, as AI tools are still very unreliable in the classroom.
I don't think so, because schools simply can't afford such expensive technology.
a: Öğrencinin özeti rolün değişeceğini, yok olmayacağını belirtiyor.

s: Reporter: Critics say the festival is too expensive for local people. / Organizer: ---- / Reporter: That's a good step. Will there be other discounts?
c: We've introduced free entry for residents on the opening day.
Our prices are actually lower than those of similar festivals.
Most of our visitors come from outside the region anyway.
We've invited several well-known local bands to perform.
a: "İyi bir adım... başka indirim olacak mı" yanıtı bir indirimden bahsedildiğini gösterir.

s: Doctor: Your blood pressure is quite high. / Patient: ---- / Doctor: Medication may help, but changes in diet and exercise are just as important.
c: Will I need to take medication for it?
I've never been to a doctor before.
I don't think I need to change anything.
a: Doktorun "ilaç yardımcı olabilir" yanıtı ilaç sorusuna verilmiş.

s: Historian: Many people think the city was destroyed by an earthquake. / Student: ---- / Historian: Exactly. The archaeological evidence points to a large fire instead.
c: But you don't agree with that view, do you?
Earthquakes are very common in this region.
I've visited the city many times.
a: "Aynen, kanıtlar yangını gösteriyor" yanıtı tarihçinin bu görüşe katılmadığını doğrular.

s: Investor: Why should I invest in your start-up? / Founder: ---- / Investor: Impressive. But how will you protect your idea from competitors?
c: Our product solves a problem millions face, and no one else offers it yet.
We've already spent most of our savings developing the prototype.
Our team is young, but we're all extremely enthusiastic about the idea.
Because the market is already full of companies selling similar products.
a: Yatırımcının "etkileyici ama rakiplerden nasıl koruyacaksınız" sorusu benzersiz bir üründen bahsedildiğini gösterir.

s: Commuter: The trains are always late these days. / Spokesperson: ---- / Commuter: I hope so, because it's affecting thousands of people every day.
c: We know, and the new signalling system should fix it by spring.
Actually, our figures show that most trains now arrive on time.
Delays are mostly caused by bad weather, which we can't control.
We apologize, but we have no budget for improvements this year.
a: Yolcunun “I hope so, because it’s affecting thousands of people” cevabı sözcünün gelecekte bir iyileşme vaadettiğini gösterir: yeni sinyalizasyon sistemi baharda sorunu çözecek. “We have no budget for improvements” umut edilecek bir şey sunmaz.

s: Teacher: Some students rely too much on online translators. / Colleague: ---- / Teacher: True, but they still need to understand the grammar themselves.
c: Well, they can be useful tools if used carefully.
I agree. We should ban them in the classroom.
Have you talked to the students about it?
Yes, I've noticed exactly the same thing in my classes.
a: "Doğru ama dilbilgisini kendileri anlamalı" yanıtı kısmi bir savunmaya karşılıktır.

s: Visitor: Why is this painting so famous? / Guide: ---- / Visitor: I see. So it changed the way artists used light.
c: It was among the first to show natural light so realistically.
Because it was stolen from the museum and missing for years.
It's the largest work in the collection, and it took ten years.
The artist painted it shortly before he died in poverty.
a: Ziyaretçinin özeti ışık kullanımından söz edildiğini gösterir.

s: Resident: The new shopping centre will kill small local shops. / Mayor: ---- / Resident: But will that really be enough to help them compete?
c: We're offering tax reductions to local shop owners.
Actually, most residents voted in favour of the project.
The centre will create hundreds of new jobs in the area.
Small shops have been closing for years for other reasons.
a: "Bu rekabet için yeterli olacak mı" itirazı bir destek önleminden bahsedildiğini gösterir.

s: Professor: Your thesis needs a clearer research question. / Student: ---- / Professor: That's much better. Now you can focus your literature review.
c: How about "What influences how young people vote in local elections?"
I've been reading a lot of articles on the topic this week.
Could you give me an example of a good research question?
I think my question is already clear enough, to be honest.
a: Profesörün "çok daha iyi" yanıtı yeni bir araştırma sorusu önerildiğini gösterir.

s: Farmer: The drought has destroyed most of my crops. / Official: ---- / Farmer: That will help, but we also need a long-term solution to water shortages.
c: The government will give emergency aid to affected farmers.
I'm afraid there's no money left in this year's farming budget.
Experts say this year's drought is the worst in decades.
You should have insured your crops against bad weather.
a: "Yardımcı olur ama uzun vadeli çözüm de gerek" yanıtı kısa vadeli bir desteğe verilmiş.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Honey is one of the few foods that never spoils. ----. This is because its low water content and high acidity make it impossible for bacteria to grow.
c: Pots of honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs were still perfectly edible
Honey has been used as a natural sweetener since prehistoric times
However, it must be stored in the fridge once the jar is opened
Bees make honey by collecting nectar from flowers and storing it in their hives
a: Bozulmama iddiasını örnekle destekleyen ve "This is because" ile açıklanan cümle: mezarlarda yenilebilir bal bulunması.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Many people believe that goldfish have a memory of only three seconds. ----. In experiments, goldfish have been trained to respond to sounds and colours and remembered them for months.
c: However, research has shown that this is a myth
Goldfish are the most popular pets in the world
Goldfish can live for more than twenty years
Some fish can change their colour
a: "Yaygın inanış" ardından deneylerle çürütme: "However, this is a myth".

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Regular reading has many benefits for children. It improves their vocabulary and helps them concentrate for longer periods. ----. For this reason, parents are encouraged to read with their children every day.
c: It also develops their imagination and empathy
Books have become very expensive recently
Many libraries are closing because of budget cuts
a: Yararları sıralamaya devam eden ve "For this reason" sonucuna bağlanan cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The city has decided to ban cars from its historic centre at weekends. ----. Local shop owners, however, are worried that fewer customers will visit their businesses.
c: The aim is to cut pollution and make the area nicer for pedestrians
Shop owners in the area have strongly welcomed this decision
A similar ban was abandoned two years ago after just one month of trials
Similar bans in other cities have led to a drop in sales
a: Kararın amacını açıklayan ve ardından "however" ile karşı görüşe geçilen cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Coffee was first discovered in Ethiopia. According to legend, a goat herder noticed that his goats became very energetic after eating berries from a certain tree. ----. From there, coffee spread to the Arabian Peninsula and later to the rest of the world.
c: He tried the berries himself and soon felt the same effect
The goats were soon sold at a high price in the local market
Coffee plants grow best at high altitudes in tropical regions
Goats in that region still graze on wild coffee plants today
a: Efsanenin devamı: çobanın da meyveleri denemesi; "From there" ile yayılma.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Sleep is essential for good health. While we sleep, our bodies repair damaged cells and our brains process information from the day. ----. As a result, they are more likely to make mistakes and suffer from health problems.
c: Those who regularly sleep under six hours often struggle to concentrate
Most adults need between seven and nine hours of sleep a night
Many people listen to calm music at night to help them fall asleep faster
Some people find it easier to fall asleep after light exercise
a: Boşluktan sonraki “As a result, they are more likely to make mistakes” cümlesinde “they” uykusuz kişileri gösterir ve hata yapmanın sebebi bekler: düzenli olarak altı saatten az uyuyanlar konsantre olmakta zorlanır. “Most adults need seven to nine hours” hata yapma sonucunu açıklamaz.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The Olympic Games originated in ancient Greece more than 2,700 years ago. ----. The modern Games were revived in 1896, when athletes from fourteen countries competed in Athens.
c: They were held every four years until they were banned in 393 AD
Only free Greek men were allowed to take part in the competitions
Winners received a crown of olive leaves rather than a medal
Today, the Summer Games include more than thirty different sports
a: Antik oyunların devamını ve sona erişini anlatıp moderne geçiş sağlayan cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Plastic pollution has become one of the greatest environmental challenges of our time. Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic end up in the oceans. ----. Some scientists estimate that by 2050 there could be more plastic than fish in the sea by weight.
c: Much of it breaks into tiny particles that marine animals then eat
Plastic bags were first introduced in supermarkets in the 1960s
Several countries have recently banned single-use plastic bags in supermarkets
Glass and metal can be recycled far more easily than plastic
a: Okyanustaki plastiğin etkisini sürdüren ve sonraki tahmine bağlanan cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Learning a second language has benefits that go beyond communication. Studies show that bilingual people are often better at solving problems and switching between tasks. ----. Some research even suggests that speaking two languages may delay the onset of dementia.
c: This may be because constantly switching between languages exercises the brain
English is the most widely spoken language in the world
Many people find grammar the most difficult part of learning a language
Children learn languages more easily than adults
a: Boşluk, iki dillilerin problem çözmede daha iyi olduğu bulgusunu açıklamalı, ardından “even” ile daha güçlü bir bulguya geçilmelidir: diller arasında sürekli geçiş beyni çalıştırır. “English is the most widely spoken language” iki dilliliğin yararlarıyla ilgisizdir.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Bees play a vital role in agriculture. ----. Without them, many fruits and vegetables would become scarce and expensive. Unfortunately, bee populations have declined sharply in recent decades.
c: They pollinate about a third of the crops that humans eat
Honeybees were first kept by humans thousands of years ago
A single colony can contain as many as fifty thousand bees
Some farmers rent hives to produce honey for local markets
a: "Without them" öncesinde arıların tarımdaki rolünü açıklayan cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — In the past, most people worked for the same company for their entire lives. ----. Today, young workers change jobs on average every three to four years.
c: However, this pattern has changed dramatically in recent decades
Similarly, young people today prefer to stay in one job for life
Many employers believe that this trend will continue in the future
Such loyalty is still the norm in most industries today
a: Paragraf geçmişte insanların ömür boyu aynı şirkette çalıştığını, bugün ise sık iş değiştirdiğini anlatır; boşluk bu geçişi “however” ile kurmalıdır. “Such loyalty is still the norm in most industries today” sonraki cümleyle çelişir.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The Amazon rainforest is often called "the lungs of the Earth". ----. However, large areas of the forest are being cut down every year for farming and cattle ranching.
c: It produces much of the world's oxygen and absorbs vast amounts of carbon dioxide
Farmers in the region depend on the land to make a living
Few people realize how quickly this vast forest is now disappearing
Much of the forest has already been lost to logging and fires
a: Benzetmeyi açıklayan cümle, "However" ile tahribata geçiliyor.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Volunteering can be good for both the community and the volunteer. ----. In addition, studies have found that people who volunteer regularly tend to be happier and healthier.
c: It helps people develop new skills and meet people from other backgrounds
However, many volunteers give up after only a few months
Most volunteers are retired people or university students
Yet some critics say volunteering takes jobs away from paid workers
a: Gönüllünün kazanımlarını sıralayan, "In addition" ile devam eden cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Fast fashion has made clothes cheaper than ever before. ----. As a result, millions of tonnes of textiles are thrown away every year, much of which ends up in landfill.
c: Since clothes are so cheap, people buy more and wear them only a few times
Some brands have started using recycled fabrics in their clothes
However, the quality of the clothes has improved in recent years
Much of this clothing is produced in factories in Asia
a: “As a result, millions of tonnes of textiles are thrown away” sonucu, öncesinde aşırı tüketimi gerektirir: giysiler ucuz olduğu için insanlar fazla alıp az giyer. “Some brands have started using recycled fabrics” atığı azaltan bir gelişmedir, atık artışını açıklamaz.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The invention of the printing press in the 15th century transformed European society. Before it, books were copied by hand and were extremely expensive. ----. This led to a rapid spread of knowledge and ideas.
c: With the printing press, books could be produced quickly and cheaply
As a result, only the rich and members of the clergy could afford to own them
Many monks spent their entire lives copying religious texts by hand
Gutenberg had worked as a goldsmith before he built his press
a: Boşluktan sonra gelen “This led to a rapid spread of knowledge” bir yeniliğin sonucunu anlatır; o yenilik de kitapların hızlı ve ucuz basılabilmesidir. “Only the rich could afford them” matbaa öncesi durumu anlatır, bilginin yayılmasına yol açmaz.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Many cities are now planting trees along their streets. Trees provide shade, which can lower temperatures in summer. ----. Furthermore, studies suggest that green spaces can improve people's mental health.
c: They also absorb pollutants and improve air quality
Some trees can live for thousands of years
Wood is used to make furniture and paper
Autumn is the most beautiful season in many cities
a: Paragraf ağaçların yararlarını sıralar (gölge, serinlik); boşluk yeni bir yarar eklemeli, ardından “Furthermore” ile bir yarar daha gelmelidir: kirleticileri emer, hava kalitesini artırır. “Wood is used to make furniture” şehirdeki ağaçların yararıyla ilgisizdir.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Antibiotics are among the most important medical discoveries of the 20th century. ----. Doctors warn that if this trend continues, common infections could once again become deadly.
c: However, their overuse has produced bacteria that resist them
Penicillin, the first of them, was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928
They have saved millions of lives since they first became available
Since then, scientists have developed many new types of antibiotics
a: "This trend" ve uyarı, aşırı kullanım/direnç cümlesini gerektirir.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — For centuries, scientists believed that the adult brain could not produce new neurons. ----. This discovery has given hope to people suffering from brain injuries and neurodegenerative diseases.
c: Recent research, however, has shown that new neurons form throughout life
The human brain contains around 86 billion neurons at birth
This belief was based on early studies of damaged brain tissue
As a result, brain injuries were thought to be permanent
a: Sonraki cümledeki “This discovery” bir keşfi işaret eder; boşluk eski inancı çürüten bulguyu vermelidir: yeni nöronlar yaşam boyu oluşur. “This belief was based on early studies” bir keşif bildirmez ve beyin hasarı olanlara umut vermez.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Urban farming, the practice of growing food in cities, is becoming increasingly popular. Rooftop gardens and vertical farms allow city residents to produce fresh vegetables close to where they live. ----. Nevertheless, critics argue that urban farms cannot produce enough food to feed large populations.
c: This cuts the need for long-distance transport and lowers emissions
However, land in city centres is often extremely expensive
Critics also point out that such farms are expensive to build
Farming has been practised in rural areas around the world for thousands of years
a: Yararı ekleyen ve "Nevertheless" ile eleştiriye geçen cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The four-day working week has been tested by companies in several countries. ----. Employees, meanwhile, report lower stress levels and a better work–life balance.
c: Many of these firms found that productivity stayed the same or rose
However, most employers rejected the idea before it was tested
Most workers in these countries still work five days a week
Some employees, however, found the longer working days tiring and stressful
a: İşverenler açısından sonucu veren, "meanwhile" ile çalışanlara geçilen cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Desert plants have developed remarkable ways of surviving with very little water. Some, like cacti, store water in their thick stems. ----. Still others have leaves covered with a waxy layer that reduces water loss.
c: Others have very long roots that reach water deep underground
Most deserts receive less than 250 millimetres of rain each year
Cacti can survive for months without receiving any rainfall
Some desert animals get all the water they need from food
a: “Some … Others … Still others” sıralaması bitkilerin farklı yöntemlerini sayar; boşluk “Others” ile başlayan yeni bir bitki yöntemi gerektirir: suya ulaşan çok uzun kökler. “Cacti can survive for months” yine kaktüsten söz eder ve yeni bir yöntem eklemez.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Social media platforms have changed how news spreads. Information can now reach millions of people within minutes. ----. This has made it more important than ever for users to check the sources of what they read.
c: At the same time, false information can spread just as fast
As a result, people are reading more news than ever before
Many newspapers now publish their stories on social media too
Some platforms now let users share news only with close friends
a: Sonraki cümle “This has made it more important … to check the sources” der; bu, yanlış bilginin yayılmasını gerektirir: yanlış bilgi de aynı hızla yayılabilir. “People are reading more news than ever before” kaynak kontrolü gereğini açıklamaz.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The ancient city of Pompeii was buried under volcanic ash when Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 AD. ----. Today, it offers archaeologists a unique picture of daily life in the Roman Empire.
c: The ash preserved it so well that buildings and even food survived
The city was rebuilt by the Romans only a few years later
Mount Vesuvius has erupted many times since then, most recently in 1944
Its ruins were destroyed again by a second eruption a century later
a: Pompeii’nin bugün günlük yaşamın eşsiz bir tablosunu sunabilmesi, külün kenti çok iyi korumuş olmasıyla açıklanır. “The city was rebuilt by the Romans” ya da yeniden yıkıldığını söyleyen cümle, korunmuş bir kentin varlığıyla çelişir.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Electric cars are often promoted as a solution to climate change. ----. Therefore, their environmental benefit depends largely on how the electricity they use is produced.
c: Yet if their power comes from coal, their emissions may still be high
Many governments now offer generous tax breaks to people who buy them
However, charging their batteries can still take several hours
They are also much quieter than cars with petrol or diesel engines
a: "Therefore ... elektriğin nasıl üretildiğine bağlı" öncesinde kömür sınırlaması.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Laughter is not only a response to humour; it also has an important social function. ----. Researchers have found that people are thirty times more likely to laugh when they are with others than when they are alone.
c: It helps to build and strengthen relationships between people
Babies begin to laugh at around three or four months of age
Laughing also reduces stress hormones and strengthens the immune system
Some comedians spend years perfecting a single joke
a: Sosyal işlevi açıklayan ve başkalarıyla gülme bulgusuna bağlanan cümle.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Many endangered species are now being bred in zoos. ----. Critics, however, argue that animals bred in captivity often struggle to survive in the wild.
c: The aim is to release them into the wild once their numbers recover
Visitors can learn a great deal about these animals by watching them
Zoos often exchange animals with one another to avoid inbreeding
However, many zoos lack the space to keep large animals
a: Boşluk hayvanat bahçelerinde üretimin amacını vermeli, ardından eleştirmenler bu amaca itiraz etmelidir: sayıları artınca hayvanları doğaya salmak. Eleştiri (“often struggle to survive in the wild”) yalnızca doğaya salma amacıyla bağlantılıdır.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — The Silk Road was not a single road but a network of trade routes connecting East and West. ----. Ideas, religions and technologies also travelled along these routes, shaping the cultures of many civilizations.
c: Merchants carried silk, spices and precious metals along these routes
Many of these routes crossed dangerous deserts and high mountains
The term "Silk Road" was first used by a German geographer in the 19th century
Most travellers only covered a short section of the network
a: Boşluktan sonraki “Ideas, religions and technologies also travelled” cümlesindeki “also”, öncesinde ticaret mallarının taşındığından söz edildiğini gösterir: tüccarlar ipek, baharat ve değerli maden taşıdı. Yolların tehlikeli çöller ve dağlardan geçmesi bilgisi “also” ile bağlanamaz.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Some psychologists argue that boredom can be beneficial. ----. For this reason, they suggest that children should not be kept busy every minute of the day.
c: When bored, our minds tend to wander, which can spark creative ideas
However, most people try to avoid boredom whenever they can
Children today spend more time on screens than ever before
It is one of the most common complaints among teenagers
a: “For this reason, children should not be kept busy every minute” sonucu, can sıkıntısının yararını açıklayan bir gerekçe ister: can sıkılınca zihin dolaşır ve yaratıcı fikirler doğar. “Most people try to avoid boredom” bu tavsiyeyi gerekçelendirmez.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Glaciers around the world are melting at an alarming rate. ----. In addition, as glaciers disappear, millions of people who depend on them for drinking water and agriculture will face shortages.
c: This contributes to rising sea levels, which threaten coastal areas
Most of the world's glaciers are found in Antarctica and Greenland
They are formed from snow that builds up over hundreds of years
Some glaciers have become popular destinations for adventurous tourists
a: Boşluktan sonraki “In addition” ikinci bir sonuca geçer; boşluk eriyen buzulların ilk sonucunu vermelidir: deniz seviyesinin yükselmesine katkı. “Most of the world’s glaciers are found in Antarctica and Greenland” bir sonuç bildirmez.

s: Boşluğa en uygun cümle hangisidir? — Handwriting is becoming less common as people increasingly type on computers and phones. ----. Some schools have therefore decided to continue teaching handwriting despite the rise of digital devices.
c: Yet studies suggest it helps students remember more than typing does
Most exams are now taken on computers rather than on paper
Typing is also much faster and easier to correct than handwriting
As a result, many schools have stopped teaching it altogether
a: "Therefore ... continue teaching" öncesinde el yazısının faydası.

s: Hangi cümle paragrafın anlam bütünlüğünü bozar? — The giraffe is the tallest animal on Earth. (I) Its long neck allows it to reach leaves high up in trees. (II) Adult giraffes can grow up to six metres tall. (III) Despite their height, giraffes have only seven neck bones, the same as humans. (IV) Elephants are the largest land animals in the world.
a: Paragraf zürafayı anlatıyor; (IV) fillere geçerek bütünlüğü bozar.

s: Hangi cümle paragrafın anlam bütünlüğünü bozar? — Many people now work from home. (I) This saves them the time and money they would spend commuting. (II) It also allows them to organize their day more flexibly. (III) Some workers, however, feel lonely without colleagues around them. (IV) Office buildings in city centres are often very tall.
a: Paragraf evden çalışmanın artılarını (zaman, para, esneklik) ve eksisini (yalnızlık) anlatır. (IV) numaralı cümle şehir merkezindeki ofis binalarının yüksekliğinden söz eder; evden çalışma konusuyla ilgisizdir.

s: Hangi cümle paragrafın anlam bütünlüğünü bozar? — Breakfast is often called the most important meal of the day. (I) It gives the body energy after a long night without food. (II) Lunch in many countries is eaten between twelve and two. (III) People who eat breakfast tend to concentrate better at work or school. (IV) Skipping breakfast may lead to overeating later in the day.
a: Paragraf kahvaltının önemini anlatır: enerji verir, konsantrasyonu artırır, atlanırsa fazla yemeye yol açar. (II) numaralı cümle öğle yemeğinin saatlerinden söz ederek konuyu değiştirir.

s: Hangi cümle paragrafın anlam bütünlüğünü bozar? — Istanbul is a city that connects two continents. (I) The Bosphorus divides the city into a European side and an Asian side. (II) Several bridges and tunnels link the two sides. (III) Ankara has been the capital of Türkiye since 1923. (IV) Every day, millions of people cross from one continent to the other.
a: (III) Ankara'ya geçerek iki kıtayı birleştiren İstanbul konusundan sapar.

s: Hangi cümle paragrafın anlam bütünlüğünü bozar? — Recycling helps protect the environment. (I) It reduces the amount of waste sent to landfill. (II) It also saves energy and natural resources. s: Parçaya göre: — For decades, doctors advised patients with back pain to rest in bed. Recent research, however, has shown that this advice may do more harm than good. Studies indicate that people who stay active recover faster than those who rest, and they are less likely to develop long-term pain. As a result, many doctors now recommend gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, as soon as possible after the pain begins. The word "gentle" in the passage is closest in meaning to ----.
a: “Gentle exercise” yürüme ya da yüzme gibi hafif, yormayan egzersiz demektir; parçada verilen örnekler de bunu destekler. “Quick and intense” (hızlı ve yoğun) “gentle”ın tam tersidir.

s: Parçaya göre: — The Voynich manuscript is a mysterious book written in an unknown language and filled with strange drawings of plants, stars and human figures. Carbon dating has shown that it was produced in the early 15th century. Despite the efforts of professional codebreakers, linguists and computer scientists, no one has been able to read it. Some researchers believe it is an elaborate hoax, while others are convinced that it contains a real language that has simply been lost. According to the passage, the Voynich manuscript ----.
a: Parçada profesyonel şifre çözücülerin, dilbilimcilerin ve bilgisayar bilimcilerin çabalarına rağmen kimsenin el yazmasını okuyamadığı (“no one has been able to read it”) belirtilir. Bilgisayar bilimcilerin çözdüğünü söylemek bu yüzden yanlıştır; karbon tarihlemesi de 15. yüzyılı gösterir.

s: Parçaya göre: — The Voynich manuscript is a mysterious book written in an unknown language and filled with strange drawings of plants, stars and human figures. Carbon dating has shown that it was produced in the early 15th century. Despite the efforts of professional codebreakers, linguists and computer scientists, no one has been able to read it. Some researchers believe it is an elaborate hoax, while others are convinced that it contains a real language that has simply been lost. The passage suggests that researchers ----.
c: disagree about whether it contains a real language
all agree that the manuscript is an elaborate hoax
have recently proved that its language has been lost
know exactly who wrote the manuscript and why
a: Parçada bazı araştırmacıların el yazmasını ayrıntılı bir aldatmaca saydığı, bazılarının ise kaybolmuş gerçek bir dil içerdiğine inandığı söylenir; yani görüş ayrılığı vardır. “All agree that the manuscript is an elaborate hoax” bu ayrılığı yok sayar.

s: Parçaya göre: — The Voynich manuscript is a mysterious book written in an unknown language and filled with strange drawings of plants, stars and human figures. Carbon dating has shown that it was produced in the early 15th century. Despite the efforts of professional codebreakers, linguists and computer scientists, no one has been able to read it. Some researchers believe it is an elaborate hoax, while others are convinced that it contains a real language that has simply been lost. Carbon dating was used to determine ----.
c: what language it was written in
a: Parçada “Carbon dating has shown that it was produced in the early 15th century” denir; karbon tarihlemesi el yazmasının ne zaman yapıldığını belirlemek için kullanılmıştır. Hangi dilde yazıldığı ise hâlâ bilinmemektedir.

s: Parçaya göre: — In many countries, the population is ageing rapidly. People are living longer, and fewer babies are being born. This trend creates economic challenges, because a smaller working-age population must support a growing number of retired people. Some governments have responded by raising the retirement age, while others are encouraging immigration to fill gaps in the labour market. Experts agree that there is no single solution, and most countries will need a combination of policies. According to the passage, an ageing population creates economic problems because ----.
c: fewer workers have to support more retired people
young people are unwilling to work as hard as before
retired people no longer pay any taxes
immigration has stopped in most countries
a: Parçaya göre yaşlanan nüfus ekonomik sorun yaratır, çünkü daha küçük bir çalışma çağı nüfusu sayısı artan emeklileri desteklemek zorundadır. Emeklilerin vergi ödemediği ya da gençlerin daha az çalışmak istediği parçada geçmez.

s: Parçaya göre: — In many countries, the population is ageing rapidly. People are living longer, and fewer babies are being born. This trend creates economic challenges, because a smaller working-age population must support a growing number of retired people. Some governments have responded by raising the retirement age, while others are encouraging immigration to fill gaps in the labour market. Experts agree that there is no single solution, and most countries will need a combination of policies. Which of the following is mentioned as a government response?
a: Parçada hükümetlerin tepkileri olarak emeklilik yaşını yükseltmek ve iş gücü açığını kapatmak için göçü teşvik etmek sayılır. Göçün yasaklanması bunun tam tersidir; emekli maaşlarının sıfırlanması da parçada geçmez.

s: Parçaya göre: — In many countries, the population is ageing rapidly. People are living longer, and fewer babies are being born. This trend creates economic challenges, because a smaller working-age population must support a growing number of retired people. Some governments have responded by raising the retirement age, while others are encouraging immigration to fill gaps in the labour market. Experts agree that there is no single solution, and most countries will need a combination of policies. The experts mentioned in the passage believe that ----.
c: countries will need to use several different policies
raising the retirement age will solve the problem
the problem will disappear by itself
a: Parçada uzmanların tek bir çözüm olmadığı ve çoğu ülkenin politikaların bir bileşimine ihtiyaç duyacağı konusunda hemfikir olduğu söylenir. Emeklilik yaşını yükseltmek ve göçü teşvik etmek tek başına çözüm olarak değil, uygulanan örnekler olarak anılır.

s: Parçaya göre: — Honeybees communicate the location of food through a behaviour known as the "waggle dance". When a bee finds a good source of nectar, it returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern. The direction of the dance shows the direction of the food in relation to the sun, while the length of the waggle indicates how far away it is. The Austrian scientist Karl von Frisch, who decoded this behaviour, received the Nobel Prize in 1973. The "waggle dance" is used by honeybees to ----.
c: tell other bees where food can be found
attract a mate during the breeding season
warn the hive about approaching enemies
keep the hive warm during cold weather
a: Parçanın ilk cümlesi bal arılarının “waggle dance” ile besinin yerini bildirdiğini söyler; dansın yönü besinin güneşe göre yönünü, sallanma süresi de uzaklığını gösterir. Eş çekme ya da düşmana karşı uyarma parçada geçmez.

s: Parçaya göre: — Honeybees communicate the location of food through a behaviour known as the "waggle dance". When a bee finds a good source of nectar, it returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern. The direction of the dance shows the direction of the food in relation to the sun, while the length of the waggle indicates how far away it is. The Austrian scientist Karl von Frisch, who decoded this behaviour, received the Nobel Prize in 1973. According to the passage, the length of the waggle shows ----.
a: Parçada “the length of the waggle indicates how far away it is” denir: sallanmanın süresi besine olan uzaklığı gösterir. Güneşe göre konum ise dansın yönüyle anlatılır; bu ikisini karıştırmak tipik bir hatadır.

s: Parçaya göre: — Honeybees communicate the location of food through a behaviour known as the "waggle dance". When a bee finds a good source of nectar, it returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern. The direction of the dance shows the direction of the food in relation to the sun, while the length of the waggle indicates how far away it is. The Austrian scientist Karl von Frisch, who decoded this behaviour, received the Nobel Prize in 1973. Karl von Frisch is mentioned in the passage because he ----.
c: explained the meaning of the waggle dance
discovered a new species of honeybee
was the first to keep bees in Austria
taught bees to dance in a figure-of-eight
a: Karl von Frisch bu davranışın anlamını çözdüğü (“who decoded this behaviour”) için anılır ve 1973’te Nobel ödülü almıştır. Yeni bir arı türü keşfettiği ya da arılara dans öğrettiği parçada söylenmez.

s: Parçaya göre: — Before the invention of the mechanical clock, people measured time using sundials, water clocks and candles. These methods were often inaccurate, and they did not work well at night or on cloudy days. The first mechanical clocks appeared in European churches in the late 13th century. They did not have minute hands and were mainly used to signal times for prayer. Over the following centuries, clocks became smaller and more accurate, eventually changing the way people organized their working day. According to the passage, early methods of measuring time ----.
c: were more accurate than mechanical clocks
a: Parçada güneş saati, su saati ve mumların çoğu zaman hatalı olduğu (“often inaccurate”), gece ya da bulutlu havada iyi çalışmadığı belirtilir; “unreliable” bunu karşılar. Mekanik saatlerden daha doğru oldukları ya da en iyi gece çalıştıkları söylenemez.

s: Parçaya göre: — Before the invention of the mechanical clock, people measured time using sundials, water clocks and candles. These methods were often inaccurate, and they did not work well at night or on cloudy days. The first mechanical clocks appeared in European churches in the late 13th century. They did not have minute hands and were mainly used to signal times for prayer. Over the following centuries, clocks became smaller and more accurate, eventually changing the way people organized their working day. The first mechanical clocks ----.
c: were used mainly to mark times for prayer
had both an hour hand and a minute hand
were small enough to be carried around
were mostly found in private homes
a: Parçaya göre ilk mekanik saatler 13. yüzyılın sonunda Avrupa kiliselerinde ortaya çıktı ve esas olarak dua vakitlerini bildirmek için kullanıldı. Yelkovanları yoktu; bu yüzden hem akrep hem yelkovan bulunduğu bilgisi yanlıştır.

s: Parçaya göre: — Before the invention of the mechanical clock, people measured time using sundials, water clocks and candles. These methods were often inaccurate, and they did not work well at night or on cloudy days. The first mechanical clocks appeared in European churches in the late 13th century. They did not have minute hands and were mainly used to signal times for prayer. Over the following centuries, clocks became smaller and more accurate, eventually changing the way people organized their working day. It can be inferred from the passage that ----.
c: more accurate clocks changed how people organized their work
mechanical clocks were first invented in Asian monasteries
water clocks worked well at night and on cloudy days
people prayed less often once clocks had been invented
a: Parçanın sonunda saatlerin zamanla küçülüp daha doğru hâle geldiği ve sonunda insanların iş gününü düzenleme biçimini değiştirdiği söylenir. İlk mekanik saatler Asya’da değil Avrupa kiliselerinde ortaya çıkmıştır; su saatleri de gece ve bulutlu havada iyi çalışmıyordu.

s: Parçaya göre: — Many young people today describe themselves as "digital natives" because they have grown up with the internet. However, research suggests that being comfortable with technology does not necessarily mean being skilled at using it. In one study, university students who used social media every day struggled to judge whether online information was reliable. The researchers concluded that schools should teach critical thinking about online sources, rather than assuming that students already have these skills. The study mentioned in the passage found that ----.
c: daily social media users struggled to judge online information
digital natives are better at evaluating sources than adults
most university students rarely use social media platforms
schools already teach critical thinking about online sources well
a: Parçadaki çalışmada her gün sosyal medya kullanan üniversite öğrencilerinin internetteki bilginin güvenilir olup olmadığını değerlendirmekte zorlandığı bulunmuştur. Bu, “dijital yerlilerin kaynakları daha iyi değerlendirdiği” düşüncesinin tersidir.

s: Parçaya göre: — Many young people today describe themselves as "digital natives" because they have grown up with the internet. However, research suggests that being comfortable with technology does not necessarily mean being skilled at using it. In one study, university students who used social media every day struggled to judge whether online information was reliable. The researchers concluded that schools should teach critical thinking about online sources, rather than assuming that students already have these skills. The researchers recommend that ----.
c: schools should teach critical thinking about online sources
students should spend less time on social media every day
universities should limit students' access to the internet
teachers should assume that students already have these skills
a: Parçada araştırmacıların, öğrencilerin bu becerilere zaten sahip olduğunu varsaymak yerine okulların çevrim içi kaynaklar hakkında eleştirel düşünmeyi öğretmesi gerektiği sonucuna vardığı söylenir. Sosyal medya süresini kısıtlamak önerilmez.

s: Parçaya göre: — Many young people today describe themselves as "digital natives" because they have grown up with the internet. However, research suggests that being comfortable with technology does not necessarily mean being skilled at using it. In one study, university students who used social media every day struggled to judge whether online information was reliable. The researchers concluded that schools should teach critical thinking about online sources, rather than assuming that students already have these skills. The main idea of the passage is that ----.
c: being familiar with technology does not mean using it well
young people are less interested in technology than before
information found on social media is generally reliable
digital natives tend to perform better at university
a: Parçanın ana fikri, teknolojiyle rahat olmanın onu iyi kullanabilmek anlamına gelmediğidir; çalışma ve öneri bu fikri destekler. Gençlerin teknolojiye ilgisinin azaldığı ya da sosyal medyadaki bilginin genellikle güvenilir olduğu parçada geçmez.

s: "I used to play the violin when I was younger." cümlesinin en doğru çevirisi hangisidir?
